decisions.rationale: The retry ledger now names its device location: ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/acstack-read-guard-<uid>/<session_id>.json for Claude Code and Codex, process memory for Pi, with a 0700 owner-checked folder, one file per session, and OS temp cleanup.

Moving project data to a global ACStack folder keyed per project is an ACStack-wide data-layout change that affects every skill and the tracked-settings opt-in, so it belongs in its own decision. The read guard keeps .acstack/project.yaml and reads it through one settings function, so a later move changes one place.
